title: Juvenile in Custody
summary: Steps for a person under 18 taken into custody.

steps.text: Notify a parent or guardian as soon as possible; document the time
Keep the juvenile out of sight and sound of adult detainees
Questioning: Miranda with a parent present whenever possible (Presha)
Consider a stationhouse adjustment for a minor offense
Contact juvenile intake or the on-call Family judge about detention
Release to a parent or guardian, or transport as ordered
Complete juvenile complaint and reports; keep records confidential

note: Follow your department's policy and current AG directives. Not yet verified against official sources.
